title: Verify frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a verify document. Its four body sections — traceability, plan adherence, tool gates, dispositions — are generated from the fact-gatherer rather than written by hand: a hand-maintained traceability table beside the real tests drifts the moment anything is refactored, and nothing detects it.

outcome.description: A verify document never passes quietly: an unconverged cycle leaves with a named reason.

suppression-count.description: Tracked because a zero-warning build is a strong signal BECAUSE it is binary — and the failure mode is not warnings appearing, it is suppressions accumulating until the zero means nothing. An increase over the previous cycle is itself a finding.

undispositioned.description: Blocking findings with no recorded disposition. Must be zero to pass — every finding, from adversary or tool, at any severity, is dispositioned.

allOf.$comment: Passing requires every verifiable criterion covered and nothing left undispositioned. Those are the two conditions the document exists to assert, so they cannot be asserted loosely.
A tier-escalated halt must record both numbers, or the reason it halted is unreadable.
